title: docs(plugin-auth): boot reachability docblock and self-hosting open-posture sentence after #36312
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pb2t8Z8C64PkPyVt1

Follow-up of PR #36312 (#34971), carried from contract review 7076202877 nits N1 and N3. Prose only; no behaviour change. Filed under the maintainer's 2026-11-22 07:49Z rule that small follow-ups go to their own card.

**N1.** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/boot-sign-in-reachability.ts` (docblock and boot message) still says the invitation branch is read before the posture switch and that the carve-out admits the one invited creation under every posture. After #36312 the posture rule is read first for `open` and on-allowlist `email_domain`; the verdict-level claim still holds (its pin is green), but the mechanism sentence is now imprecise. Reword the docblock and the message to match `decideAudienceAdmission`'s order.

**N3.** `content/docs/deployment/self-hosting.mdx`: the sentence "Under `open` every address is admitted by the posture" omits the exception the #36312 changeset states (a social creation with an unverified address while verification is in force). Add the half-clause.

Done when: both sentences match the code at main; no test or behaviour change.
